questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the sentence given below.**

Richa was __provoking her neighbours against her maid Shanta who spoke against her but none of them responded.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**Egging on**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Egging on**" means to encourage or provoke someone to do something, often something negative or harmful. (किसी को कुछ करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना या उकसाना, अक्सर कुछ नकारात्मक या हानिकारक)

 
 
• **Example**: *The group of friends was egging him on to take the dare, even though they knew it was risky.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that Richa was intentionally trying to turn her neighbours against her maid, Shanta.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Smelling a rat**" means to suspect that something is wrong or suspicious. (यह संदेह करना कि कुछ गलत या संदिग्ध है)
 
• "**Carrying the conviction**" means to have a strong belief or opinion about something. (किसी चीज़ के बारे में दृढ़ विश्वास या राय रखना)
 
• "**Rising like a phoenix**" refers to the idea of something or someone being reborn or rising from the ashes. (किसी चीज़ या किसी व्यक्ति के पुनर्जन्म या राख से जीवित होने का विचार)

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A) Human relationships are a matter of great concern for every one of us.

B) Nevertheless, social scientists have attached many other elements that actually help us for a good social life.

C) As it helps us all to have a coordinated, balanced and approachable life.

D) The present generation fails to take cognisance of all such elements and fall prey to a lonely life risking happiness.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **ACBD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence A**: This sentence introduces the central theme of the paragraph, highlighting the importance of human relationships.
 
• **Sentence C**: This sentence provides a reason for the significance of human relationships, emphasizing the positive impact they have on our lives.
 
• **Sentence B**: This sentence introduces the idea that social scientists have identified various elements contributing to a good social life, expanding on the notion mentioned in the previous sentence.
 
• **Sentence D**: This sentence concludes the paragraph by suggesting that the current generation, despite the insights of social scientists, may neglect these elements, leading to a risk of loneliness and jeopardizing happiness.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer

questions.question:

questions.solution:

Therefore, **option 4** is the correct answer.

• "**Few and far**" means scarce or hard to come by. (दुर्लभ या कठिन होना)

questions.question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. We must not complain

B. thorns bear flowers

C. but rather be grateful that

D. that roses have thorns
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **ADCB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Part A**: This part provides the main directive or advice, instructing that complaining is not the appropriate response.
 
• **Part D**: This part introduces a fact about roses having thorns, setting the context for the advice given in part A. It establishes the idea that there is a negative aspect to something generally perceived as positive.
 
• **Part C**: This part introduces a contrasting perspective. Instead of complaining about the negative aspect, it suggests adopting a more positive mindset by being grateful for something else.
 
• **Part B**: This part concludes the sentence by providing a metaphorical or symbolic explanation. It reinforces the idea that even though there are negative aspects (thorns), they can lead to something beautiful or positive (flowers).
 
• So, when arranged in the sequence **ADCB**, the parts form a coherent and meaningful sentence with a clear flow of thought.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.
